items.title: Organizational ledgers were incomplete and mutually contradictory
items.evidence: Found at START_SHA: commit registry omitted 11 Wave-10 worker commits and all 37 V2 control-plane commits; evidence registry cited 2 of 11 Wave-10 reports only; mission-state and wave-history named two different run IDs for the same current wave; mission-state last_control_plane_commit was 5 commits behind HEAD.

items.title: Stable-ID allocation collision in next_id fields
items.evidence: work-registry.next_id was WORK-0007 while a WORK-0007 item already existed; wave-history.next_id was WAVE-0011 while WAVE-0011 was in use. Both are corrected to the first unused permanent ID.

items.title: Evidence registry cited source paths absent from the target branch
items.verification_work: Integrator promotion of QC-passed Wave-10 artifacts
items.evidence: EVIDENCE-0003 and EVIDENCE-0004 cite .kilo/team/results/benchmark-123/result.md and .kilo/team/results/intelligence-brain/result.md; neither path exists on the target branch at START_SHA. Both are resolvable only on unpromoted worker branches. Root cause is BLOCKER-0001. The findings are preserved; only their promotion state is recorded.

items.title: Organizational memory and the repository target branch are on divergent lineages
items.verification_work: Governed branch-lineage reconciliation by INTEGRATOR + MISSION_DIRECTOR
items.evidence: FACT at START_SHA 6c9d4da5b04a1063e9fe616c2b1c4d9fd072397b: the eight memory ledgers exist only on origin/fix/autonomous-product-factory (which is the START_SHA tip). origin/main contains no .kilo/team/memory/ directory at all. The two lineages share merge-base 99542164a06f15aa4072a52b9debcf75125a358a (2026-08-28); origin/main carries 79 commits absent from START_SHA and START_SHA carries 662 commits absent from origin/main. Ten of the thirteen pre-existing commit-registry records (COMMIT-0002..COMMIT-0011) resolve only on origin/main, and twelve origin/main team-control-plane commits (c6676993..fdd289c2) post-date the commit mission-state named as the last control-plane commit.
items.impact: Organizational memory describes one lineage while the repository's default branch carries a different, newer control plane. Any completeness or completeness-of-promotion claim made from memory alone is therefore unsafe for the lineage it does not describe.
